Frax is a DeFi protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Frax issues the FRAX stablecoin. Frax has used partial collateralization in the design of its stablecoin.

Liquid Collective is a liquid staking protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Liquid Collective issues the LsETH token to stakers. Liquid Collective operates without a custodial intermediary.

LsETH is a liquid staking token on the Ethereum blockchain. LsETH is issued by Liquid Collective. LsETH represents staked ether that remains liquid for use in other DeFi applications.
